ecori.summary: Mid-level developer on a B2B e-commerce platform for solar energy equipment resellers, building new features and keeping the production system maintainable.

highlights.title: Performance optimization
highlights.text: Refactored critical routines and optimized queries with Dapper and EF Core, cutting a critical query's response time from 4s to 400ms (a 90% drop).

highlights.title: Stack migration
highlights.text: Took part in migrating part of the legacy platform from .NET 8 / Angular 11 to .NET 10 / Angular 22, reducing technical debt and removing security vulnerabilities.

highlights.title: Architecture and patterns
highlights.text: Applied Vertical Slice Architecture, DDD and CQRS to microservices development, ensuring separation of concerns and sustainable code evolution.

highlights.title: Collaboration and quality
